phase: CD-2A — Axis Discretization (sublayer of CD-2 L2 Sector Observable State Model)
supersedes: cd2a-prereg-v1 (2026-10-04) — freeze_rule deleted by user ruling 2026-10-21
authority: user GO ruling 2026-10-04 — 'L2 sector observable-state operationalization' NOT a lifecycle classifier; observation layer states facts, interpretation layer economics; intent words (吸筹/派发/主力) prohibited in observation layer. PLUS user ruling 2026-10-21 — '不要冻结' : thresholds are NOT frozen.
inputs: CD-1B four-axis table (docs/cd/cd1b_axes_run.json + data/cd/sector_axes/l2_four_axes.json.gz, sha 0f747662efa35818); OK rows only (98,013); INSUFFICIENT_PARTICIPATION/NO_TRADING_MEMBERS rows propagate as INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT — never rescued

development_window.fit_rule: thresholds are re-derived from the dev window on a REFIT only (a slow-frequency data update event, user-triggered) — see refit_cadence. Between refits the daily chain CARRIEs them. There is no immutable threshold constant and no 'freeze once' event. Re-derivation is the official method, not a violation.
development_window.pit_cleanliness: the fit window ends 2023-12-29 and never contains a holdout date, so every refit is a function of strictly prior data only. Refitting does NOT introduce look-ahead.
development_window.holdout: 2024-01-01..2026-09-30 — ZERO threshold fitting on holdout; holdout bands are pure application of the current dev-window thresholds
development_window.refit_visibility: every refit appends a record to docs/cd/cd2a_threshold_history.jsonl (threshold deltas, previous/current band_table_sha256, compared_rows, changed_rows, flips_by_axis). If a refit moves band labels that is an EXPECTED and LOGGED event — neither a failure nor a silent overwrite.
development_window.refit_cadence: user ruling 2026-10-21 (2nd, same day): a refit fires on the slow-frequency data update event, not on a per-day schedule. Step C1A of the daily chain CARRYs thresholds + stratum map from docs/cd/cd2a_thresholds.json and only rebuilds the band table; `--refit` runs only when the user has updated slow-frequency data (e5 weekly / holders on the 1st / institutional quarterly / universe refresh) and asks for it. The refit cadence is therefore the slow-data cadence. Every run (either mode) still appends fit_basis_sha to the log, so an overdue refit and any drift under carried thresholds stay visible. Entry point: scripts/h_refit_thresholds.sh.
development_window.prohibited: manual/ad-hoc threshold tuning to make states 'look more reasonable'; any threshold value derived from a holdout date; post-hoc switching between pooled and stratified thresholds

RP_axis.variable: rel_eq_mkt (sector equal-weight return minus market equal-weight return, per day)
RP_axis.bands: LOW / MID / HIGH via dev-window quantiles q33/q67 pooled over all (sector,date) OK rows
RP_axis.sensitivity_only: rel_vw_mkt same discretization recorded but NOT used in state generation (declared sensitivity, avoids dual-track freedom)

PARTICIPATION_axis.variable: d_share = vol_share - vol_share_20d (current participation vs its own trailing 20-day level, per sector-day)
PARTICIPATION_axis.bands: FALLING / FLAT / EXPANDING via dev-window quantiles q33/q67 of d_share
PARTICIPATION_axis.note: labels describe trading participation change ONLY; 'capital inflow/outflow' is prohibited phrasing (volume proxy, amount gap declared in CD-1B)

BREADTH_axis.bands: LOW / MID / HIGH via dev-window quantiles q33/q67
BREADTH_axis.sensitivity_only: new_high_frac recorded alongside, not in state generation

CONCENTRATION_axis.variable: ret_contrib_top5 (top5 share of positive return contributions)
CONCENTRATION_axis.bands: LOW / MID / HIGH via dev-window quantiles q33/q67
CONCENTRATION_axis.null_days: ret_contrib_top5 is NULL on no-positive-contribution days (4.1% of OK rows) -> concentration band = NULL, state emission rules handle NULL explicitly (never imputed)

DISPERSION_axis.variable: ret_gap = top5_mean_ret - rest_mean_ret (volume-ranked top5 vs rest)
DISPERSION_axis.bands: LOW / MID / HIGH via dev-window quantiles q33/q67
DISPERSION_axis.null_days: NULL when sector-day has <6 participants (2.6%) -> handled explicitly

per_axis: annual q33/q67 stability across 2021/2022/2023 dev years
census_protocol_support_first.sector_size_stratification: members groups SMALL(5-14)/MID(15-49)/LARGE(>=50) by median participating n; per-axis q33/q67 WITHIN each size stratum; if cross-stratum threshold drift > 0.10 in band probability terms (fraction of MID-band under other stratum's thresholds differs by >10pp), ADOPT SIZE-STRATIFIED THRESHOLDS — else single pooled thresholds
census_protocol_support_first.decision_rule: census decides pooled vs stratified BEFORE any state is computed; the choice and its evidence are recorded in the threshold table; no post-hoc switching

output_contracts.cd2a_threshold_table: docs/cd/cd2a_thresholds.json — per axis: variable, window, pooled q33/q67, stratum q33/q67 (if adopted), drift evidence, refit timestamp, census sha. NO freeze timestamp (v1 field 'frozen_at' retired).
output_contracts.cd2a_refit_log: docs/cd/cd2a_threshold_history.jsonl — append-only one line per run, tagged mode=refit (thresholds re-derived) or mode=carry (thresholds carried, band table rebuilt); this is how threshold and band movement is made visible
output_contracts.cd2a_band_table: data/cd/sector_axes/l2_axis_bands.json.gz — per (sector,date): band per axis + INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT propagation; deterministic dual-run sha check
output_contracts.coverage_report: per-sector band emission counts + NULL counts per axis (concentration/dispersion NULL days explicit)

change_log.change: refit cadence pinned to the slow-frequency data update event (2nd ruling, same day). Step C1A of the daily chain now CARRYs thresholds + stratum map and only rebuilds the band table; `--refit` is run only after the user has updated slow-frequency data and asks for it. Reason: C1A joined the daily chain on 2026-10-21, so 'refit' had silently become a per-day rewrite under micro-drifting input — which is not what 'refit on new information' was meant to mean. A carry run that WOULD have moved bands is still logged (mode=carry + fit_basis_sha + fit_basis_changed_since_refit + changed_rows), so nothing is silenced.

freeze_rule deleted. Replaced by refit-per-run + mandatory append-only refit log. Rationale: (1) the freeze was never implemented in code — docs/cd/cd2a_thresholds.json was written on every run and read by nothing, so 'frozen' was a nominal claim only; (2) a freeze that is not mechanically enforced cannot be relied on, and enforcing it required holding thresholds constant across upstream data revisions, which is itself an unstated modelling choice; (3) PIT-cleanliness is preserved by the fit-window boundary, not by immutability. v1's 'CONTRACT VIOLATION (Phase J lesson)' clause is retired.
